recalled_knowledge.item: Anand et al. Table 1 entry 10: L10 = (d10/m_v^2)(chibar i sigma^{mu nu} q_nu/m_M chi)(Nbar i sigma_{mu rho} q^rho/m_M N) -> 4 (m_N^2/m_M^2)[(q^2/m_N^2) O4 - O6]; m_M = nucleon mass
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: Anand, Fitzpatrick, Haxton PRC 89 (2014) 065501; re-derived in details.md 3.1

recalled_knowledge.item: NR reduction of photon-mediated magnetic-dipole DM: c1 = e mu Q/(2 m_chi), c5 = 2 e mu m_N Q/q^2, c4 = e mu g_N/m_N, c6 = -e mu g_N m_N/q^2
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: Fitzpatrick et al. 2012 Eq. 45; Gresham & Zurek 2014; Banks-Fox-Weiner 2010; Barger-Keung-Marfatia 2011; re-derived in details.md 3.2

recalled_knowledge.item: Heavy-vector dipole-dipole matching d10/(m_v^2 m_M^2) = mu_chi^V mu_N^V / M^2
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: tree-level integration of a massive vector with (mu/2) psibar sigma psi V_{mu nu} couplings

recalled_knowledge.item: LZ 2024 WIMP search exposure 4.2 t yr (5.5 t x 280 live days, SR1 + WS2024), PRL 135, 011802 (2025), arXiv:2410.17036
2024 LZ low-energy search tolerated of order 3-5 signal events in its ROI at high mass
